title: Missing Metrics for Some Synthetic Monitoring Checks using the Montreal, North Virginia, and North California public probes

updates.body:
Between approximately 08:09 and 09:10 UTC on 2 November (about 1 hour 11 minutes), a subset of Synthetic Monitoring checks running from the Montreal, North Virginia, and North California public probe locations experienced missing metrics, which may have appeared as gaps in dashboards. Specifically this affected:

Checks with the Montreal Public Probe from 08:09-09:00 UTC
Checks with the North Virginia Public Probe from 08:22-09:06 UTC
Checks with the North California Public Probe from 08:43-09:20 UTC

This has been fully resolved and all services are operating normally.

title: GitHub returning 403 for all Git Sync repositories
components: Federal Cloud - AWS US Gov West

updates.body: Since ~21:40 UTC on Nov 3, GitHub started rejecting the default User-Agent our Git Sync client sends (nanogit/0), so nearly every GitHub-backed repo shows as unhealthy ("not authorized") and syncs are being skipped. Our Engineering team has rolled out a fix to development and validated that the fix works. We will roll out the fix to production shortly and will provide another update.
The fix has landed in 60% of production. We are currently monitoring as it lands in the remaining clusters.
The fix has been deployed to all production clusters and we are observing a continued period of stability. At this time, we are marking the incident as resolved.
